from hashlib import sha256
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.request import urlopen
import json,tempfile
out=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='resolena-country-source-'))
resources=[('countryInfo.txt','https://download.geonames.org/export/dump/countryInfo.txt'),('readme.txt','https://download.geonames.org/export/dump/readme.txt'),('cc-by-4.0.html','https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/')]
records=[]
for filename,url in resources:
    started=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    try:
        with urlopen(url,timeout=25) as response:
            raw=response.read()
            record={'reference':url,'resolved_reference':response.geturl(),'HTTP_status':response.status,
                'retrieval_started_at':started,'retrieved_at':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                'publisher_HTTP_last_modified':response.headers.get('Last-Modified'),
                'content_type':response.headers.get('Content-Type'),'bytes':len(raw),'sha256':sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'file':filename}
        (out/filename).write_bytes(raw)
    except Exception as error:
        record={'reference':url,'retrieval_started_at':started,'retrieved_at':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'error':str(error),'file':filename}
    records.append(record)
(out/'acquisition.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'source_directory':str(out),'acquisition':records},indent=2))
